deckTitle: Dream-Wrestling with Kayfabe-Freud: Where the Id Always Kicks Out at Two!

cards.power:
The Basement Flood
Play this card to resurrect a discarded Quest Card from the beginning of the game.
cards.lore: It's not gone. It's just downstairs, lifting weights and waiting for you to fall asleep. Style: vintage horror comic. Subject: monstrous repressed faces in flooded basement. Mood: lurking, primordial.

cards.power:
Tip of the Tongue
The current player must finish their story without using the letter "I".
cards.lore: The waiting room of the mind. Ideas sit here until they are called or kicked out. Style: noir woodcut. Subject: men in trench coats in DMV waiting room. Mood: bureaucratic dread.

cards.power:
Redaction.
Interrupt a player. They must retell their last sentence using a euphemism.
cards.lore: He keeps at the door. He doesn't let the naked truth into the party. Style: pulp comic. Subject: bald censor with TOP SECRET stamp, redacting nude figure. Mood: officious, leering.

cards.power:
Immediate Gratification
Take the die and set it to [6]. Describe your perfect victory.
cards.lore: Freud says: Every dream is a wish. Even the one where you lose your teeth. Style: kids cereal box. Subject: ecstatic dog with golden bone trophy. Mood: triumphant, manic.

cards.power:
Zip File.
Combine two Scene cards into one stack. They are now a single entity.
cards.lore: Why have one anxiety when you can smash five faces into one monster? Efficient! Style: surreal lithograph. Subject: cartoon faces crushed in giant trash compactor. Mood: comic absurdity.

cards.power:
Look Over There!
Move the Quest Die to a completely irrelevant Card on the Stage.
cards.lore: It's not about the Father. It's about the Father's coat button. Obsess over the button. Style: vintage horror comic. Subject: dragon ignored, child screams at coat button. Mood: misplaced terror.

cards.power:
Goo-Goo Ga-Ga.
Speak as your Actor, but with the vocabulary of a 3-year-old.
cards.lore: When the path forward is blocked, the mind runs backward to the crib. Style: charcoal sketch. Subject: adult man in diaper, crying in spotlight. Mood: pathetic, hilarious.

cards.power:
The Retcon.
Change the ending of the previous player's story to make it "make sense".
cards.lore: The lie we tell ourselves when we wake up, just to make the chaos look like a movie. Style: silent film. Subject: top-hat showman painting over board game with patchwork. Mood: smug revision.

cards.power:
Boring Deja Vu.
You must incorporate a mundane object from the room you are currently in into the story.
cards.lore: The trash of yesterday becomes the treasure of tonight's hallucination. Style: editorial ink. Subject: trash can with letters spilling out. Mood: mundane revelation.

cards.power:
Tantrum.
Flip the Quest Die over to its opposite side (1 becomes 6).
cards.lore: The oldest stuff lies deepest. You are still 4 years old and you want that cookie. Style: hidden-under-table. Subject: child kicking from beneath a chair. Mood: infant rage. four

cards.power: Wake Up Call. Slam the table. All players must drop their hands.
cards.lore: The body is shouting, but the dream translates it into a symphony of pain. Style: pulp horror. Subject: sleeper jolted by alarm and full bladder. Mood: rude awakening.

cards.power: Kayfa-BOOM! End the current Quest immediately. No winner.
cards.lore: The executioner of the dream. The return of the cruel, cold logic of 7:00 AM. Style: gothic woodcut. Subject: screaming alarm clock face with teeth. Mood: tyrannical morning. seven A.M.

cards.power:
Cover Up.
Place this card over an Actor. They are now "The Gentleman".
cards.lore: According to Freud, if it fits on a head, it stands in for the... other head. Style: anatomy etching. Subject: top hat over phallic chess pawn. Mood: prim innuendo.

cards.power:
Rhythmic Motion.
Tap the table rhythmically while telling your story. If you stop, you lose your turn.
cards.lore: Up and down. In and out. The rhythm of the stairs is the rhythm of love. Allegedly. Style: woodcut spiral. Subject: hypnotic staircase descending. Mood: trance, suggestion.

cards.power:
Symbolic Authority.
You are now the Boss. You decide who speaks next.
cards.lore: It hangs down. It is useless. Men wear it. Do the math. Style: limp realism. Subject: drooping tie alone on hanger. Mood: deflated authority.

cards.power:
Maternal Origin.
Treat this card as a "Home Base". Players can retreat there to avoid logic.
cards.lore: Mater comes from Mater (Mother). Wood is the universal mother-substitute. Don't ask. Style: dark fairytale woodblock. Subject: tree shaped like mother silhouette. Mood: sheltering, eerie.

cards.power:
Castration Anxiety.
The next player loses one card from their hand (randomly selected).
cards.lore: Losing a tooth in a dream isn't about dentists. It's about losing your... power. Style: medical horror. Subject: pliers yanking molar from screaming mouth. Mood: visceral dread.

cards.power:
Erection.
Rise up from your chair. You must play standing up until your next turn.
cards.lore: Defying gravity. Rising up. The dream of flying is the dream of capability. Style: vintage sci-fi. Subject: steampunk rocket lifting off. Mood: phallic ascension, comic.

cards.power:
Surrender.
You may voluntarily discard your Actor to draw 2 new cards.
cards.lore: Falling is giving in. Sometimes you want to hit the bottom. Style: existential ink. Subject: tiny figure plummeting into void. Mood: surrender, release.

cards.power:
Unwanted Sibling.
Choose another player. They are now your "Rival". You must contradict them.
cards.lore: Small animals represent small children. Usually the ones you wish weren't born. Style: Kafkaesque. Subject: cockroach in suit holding briefcase. Mood: unwanted, persistent.

cards.power:
Dad's Law:
Veto any story element that challenges authority.
cards.lore: The Father. The King. The Obstacle. He prohibits the fun. Style: storybook monarchy. Subject: scowling king on throne crushing fun. Mood: paternal tyranny.

cards.power:
Mom's Favor:
Choose a player to protect. They cannot be challenged this round.
cards.lore: The Mother. The Object. The Origin. The Forbidden Zone. Style: pre-Raphaelite. Subject: queen offering glowing apple. Mood: maternal seduction.

cards.power:
Sexual Tension.
Introduce a romantic subplot between two cards that really shouldn't be together.
cards.lore: Every dream about a burglar is a dream about a distinct kind of 'entry'. Style: noir crime comic. Subject: cat burglar through window with sack. Mood: forbidden entry.

cards.power:
Projection.
Accuse another player of the strategy you are secretly using.
cards.lore: I'm not the bad guy. YOU are the bad guy who looks exactly like me. Style: mirror-comic. Subject: two identical men pointing at each other. Mood: paranoid self-recognition.

cards.power:
Performance Anxiety.
Ask the active player a trivia question. If they fail, their turn ends.
cards.lore: You've already passed this test years ago. Why are you back here? To prove you're a fraud. Style: anxiety dream sketch. Subject: naked student at unknown test. Mood: paralyzing exposure.

cards.power:
Exposure.
Reveal your entire hand of cards to the table.
cards.lore: It's not about skin. It's about the childhood wish to show off, gone wrong. Style: Victorian woodcut. Subject: nude man calmly walking among crowd. Mood: dream-shame, public.

cards.power:
Stuck.
The Quest Die cannot be moved this turn, no matter the story.
cards.lore: You want to go, but your Will says 'No'. The conflict turns your legs to lead. Style: expressionist ink. Subject: man trying to run, legs rooted. Mood: dream-stuck, futile.

cards.power:
Absurdity.
State a fact that is clearly false, but treat it as absolute truth.
cards.lore: If you dream they are dead, you secretly wished them dead. Don't look at me, Freud said it. Style: gothic. Subject: grandmother knitting in rocking chair, slightly translucent. Mood: cozy uncanny.

cards.power:
Total Tragedy.
Destroy the current Stage. All scenes are discarded.
cards.lore: The ultimate plot twist: You were the detective AND the murderer all along. Style: Greek tragedy comic. Subject: muscular figure gouging own eyes. Mood: cosmic horror.

cards.power:
The Riddle.
The active player must speak in a rhyme.
cards.lore: The gatekeeper of the story. Solve the riddle or get strangled by your own neurosis. Style: classical engraving. Subject: sphinx with cigarette dangling. Mood: bored riddler.

cards.power:
Fate.
Force the story to take a tragic turn, regardless of logic.
cards.lore: Where you met the Father. Where you struck him down. Where it all went wrong. Style: dust-bowl noir. Subject: burning chariot at desert crossroads. Mood: doom convergence.

cards.power:
Hesitation.
Skip your turn to think about doing something, but do nothing.
cards.lore: He couldn't kill the King because he *was* the King in his dream. Analysis paralysis. Style: ink melodrama. Subject: jester holding skull, frozen mid-thought. Mood: paralyzed pondering.

cards.power:
Thick Plot.
Connect the current Story to at least 3 cards on the table.
cards.lore: Every dream image has ten different causes. It's a traffic jam of meaning. Style: alchemical chart. Subject: dense web of arrows between symbols. Mood: tangled meaning.

cards.power:
Show, Don't Tell.
You cannot use abstract words (love, freedom, justice). Only objects.
cards.lore: Dreams can't think 'Because'. They have to show two things crashing into each other. Style: pulp art class. Subject: painter pointing at canvas labeled 'Constitutional Law'. Mood: literal absurdity.

cards.power:
Reverse Psychology.
Interpret the Quest Die's [1] as [6] and [6] as [1] for this turn.
cards.lore: In the unconscious, 'No' does not exist. Every 'No' is just a 'Yes' in a mask. Style: protest poster. Subject: signs reading Left/No/Yes contradicting. Mood: contradiction.

cards.power:
Decoding.
Guess the hidden motive of another player. If right, take their card.
cards.lore: The dream is not a drawing. It is a puzzle text made of pictures. Read it, don't view it. Style: rebus puzzle ink. Subject: eye + saw + sheep equation. Mood: cryptic decoding.

cards.power:
Free Association.
Say the first word that comes into your head. The next player must start their story with it.
cards.lore: Lie down. Don't look at me. Just talk until you say something shameful. Style: Vienna 1900. Subject: empty psychoanalyst's couch with rug. Mood: confessional invitation.

cards.power:
Block.
Cancel the effect of the last card played.
cards.lore: If you refuse to talk about it, that's exactly what we need to talk about. Style: barricade woodcut. Subject: chairs piled against door. Mood: defiant blockage.

cards.power:
New Target.
Transfer the effect of a Power card to a different player.
cards.lore: You aren't mad at me. You're mad at your Dad. But I'm charging you by the hour, so go ahead. Style: vintage therapy ad. Subject: patient yelling at calm analyst. Mood: misdirected fury.

cards.power:
Insight.
Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Arrange them how you like.
cards.lore: The Royal Road to the Unconscious. Paved with bad intentions and dirty jokes. Style: Holmes pastiche. Subject: detective examining steaming poop with magnifier. Mood: comic analysis.

cards.power:
Primal Urge.
Ignore all rules for one turn. Just make something happen.
cards.lore: I want. I take. I eat. I kill. I sex. NOW. Style: Heavy Metal magazine. Subject: yellow demonic face with neon teeth. Mood: primal hunger.

cards.power:
Compromise.
Move the Quest Die to the exact center [3.5] (or just say 3 or 4).
cards.lore: The poor clown trying to serve three masters at once. Reality, Id, and Super-Ego. Style: editorial caricature. Subject: man in suit juggling demons and angels. Mood: harried compromise.

cards.power:
Guilt Trip.
Another player apologizes for their story. They lose a turn.
cards.lore: The internalized parent. It watches you shower. It judges your thoughts. Style: stern engraving. Subject: looming Mosaic patriarch staring down. Mood: surveilling judgment.

cards.power:
Cathexis.
Add +1 to the Resonance [R] of any card on the table.
cards.lore: The fuel of the mind. It has to go somewhere. If you block it, it explodes. Style: alchemical illustration. Subject: red liquid pouring through funnel into glowing vessel. Mood: charged transfer.

cards.power:
Memory Hole.
Remove a Scene card from the Stage. It never happened.
cards.lore: The best parts of the dream are the ones you can't remember. Trust me. Style: open book ink. Subject: black hole burned into page. Mood: void, forgetting.

cards.power:
Unknowable.
This card cannot be removed or affected by any other card.
cards.lore: The spot where the dream reaches down into the unknown. Don't touch it. Style: anatomical etching. Subject: dark mushroom-navel descending into shadow. Mood: forbidden depth.

cards.power:
Fade Out.
Shuffle the discard pile back into the deck.
cards.lore: The sun comes up and the truth evaporates. Back to your safe, boring life. Style: dawn watercolor. Subject: dreamscape dissolving into mist as sun rises. Mood: evaporating truth.

cards.power:
Capture.
Keep the last played Quest card as a Trophy.
cards.lore: Write it down fast, before the Censor wakes up and deletes the file. Style: bedside sketch. Subject: notepad with 'The Horse was a Toaster!!!' scrawl. Mood: feverish recall.

cards.power:
Mind Read.
Look at another player's hand.
cards.lore: Freud hated this stuff, but he couldn't quite rule it out. Spooky. Style: 1920s spiritualist. Subject: two brains in jars connected by lightning. Mood: occult science.

cards.power:
Repeat.
Play the same card you played last turn again.
cards.lore: I have been here before. Or maybe I just dreamed I was here. Whatever. Style: photocopy degradation. Subject: identical black cat photographed twice in alley. Mood: uncanny repeat.

cards.power:
Prediction.
Guess the number of the next die roll. If right, you win the Quest.
cards.lore: Is it the future? Or did you just wish for it so hard you made it happen? Style: carnival mystic. Subject: crystal ball with explosion inside. Mood: foreboding prophecy.

cards.power:
Control.
Change the rules of the game for one round. (e.g., "High rolls lose").
cards.lore: I know I am dreaming. Therefore, I am God. Now watch this backflip. Style: comic book hero. Subject: caped flyer in pajamas with hammer. Mood: drunk omnipotence.
